name: Musicians
overview: Scripture reveals that musicians play a vital role in worship by expressing joy and praise to God through singing and making music. The Psalms emphasize singing as a response to God's redemption and mighty works, encouraging believers to praise the Lord continually throughout their lives. The New Testament shows that singing hymns was part of the early church's practice, as Paul and Silas sang praises even in prison, demonstrating faith and trust in God amid trials. Thus, musicians serve as instruments of worship, lifting hearts toward God and proclaiming His salvation.
